title: Lesson 48 - I See Your Point, But…

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Thanks for meeting with me. I see now that the Friday graphics were never agreed. We have a small launch budget, and I hoped the poster could be adapted quickly.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I see your point, but I can't commit to three extra graphics as volunteer work.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I understand. Could we reduce the request to one schedule graphic? We still need something by Friday.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I understand why the timing matters; however, that item is still outside the one poster I agreed to make.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: And I should have checked with Aisha before I suggested otherwise. The Friday expectation came from my note, not from her.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: That's clear. Aisha, what part of the project can you agree to?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: What I can agree to is the original poster after the final text and permissions are approved. That commitment hasn't changed.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Would a simpler schedule graphic with no photographs work?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Not by Friday. That doesn't work for me because my current client deadlines are already fixed.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I appreciate the direct answer.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: If you need more than the original poster, we'll need a separate brief, an agreed fee and a realistic turnaround.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I wish the launch budget were larger, but it isn't. For Friday, the center can use its existing neutral schedule template.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: That keeps the urgent need separate from Aisha's commitment.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Yes. I'll withdraw the Friday request and remove Aisha's name from that task.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Thank you. If funding is approved later, send the extra brief and I'll decide after reviewing it. Please don't list me as assigned before I answer.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Agreed. Nothing additional will be assigned without your written acceptance.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: My correction also says that the original poster depends on approved text and permissions. I won't connect it to the wayfinding signs or other launch materials.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Good. I still want to contribute that one poster when the inputs are ready.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Then our confirmed version is: the center uses its template on Friday, Aisha keeps the one-poster volunteer commitment, and any extra design becomes a separate future request.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Exactly. I see the center's time pressure, but this is the version I can responsibly agree to.
